$comment: Deployment facts every platform template in deploy/<platform>/ must agree on (OpenSpec change unraid-template). Checked by scripts/deploy-check.mjs. See deploy/README.md.
name: OpenTodo
summary: Open-source, local-first task manager. Works offline and syncs every device from one small container.

variables.name: OPENTODO_BASE_URL
variables.description: The address people open, for example https://todo.example.com. Needed behind a reverse proxy for passkeys, secure cookies and links in emails. Include the port if there is one. Leave empty when you open OpenTodo by the server's address.

variables.name: OPENTODO_SETUP_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional, at least 16 characters. When set, creating the first (owner) account asks for this token, so a server reachable from the internet cannot be claimed by a stranger.

variables.name: OPENTODO_ALLOW_SIGNUP
variables.description: true lets anyone who can reach the server create an account. Otherwise the owner invites people.

variables.name: OPENTODO_TRUSTED_PROXIES
variables.description: Reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted for the visitor's address: IP addresses or ranges such as 192.0.2.0/24 separated by commas, or cloudflare. Set it only when every request comes through them.

variables.name: OPENTODO_PUSH
variables.description: on or off: reminders as push notifications (needs https).

variables.name: OPENTODO_TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Days deleted items stay in the Trash; 0 keeps them forever.

variables.name: OPENTODO_IMPORT_MAX_MB
variables.description: Largest import file accepted, in MB.

variables.name: OPENTODO_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: debug, info, warn or error. The first log line shows the level in use; debug adds one line per request the app makes.

variables.name: OPENTODO_EMAIL_ADDRESS
variables.description: Email to task: the mailbox address people send tasks to.

variables.name: OPENTODO_EMAIL_IMAP_HOST
variables.description: Email to task: the IMAP server, host:port.

variables.name: OPENTODO_EMAIL_IMAP_USER
variables.description: Email to task: the IMAP user name.

variables.name: OPENTODO_EMAIL_IMAP_PASSWORD
variables.description: Email to task: the IMAP password.
